mutation_policy: Read-only audit; no existing artifact, pack, index, or history was modified; no repack or history rewrite was performed.

summary.note: Working-tree occurrence, current-tip unique blobs, physical object storage, and historical reachable content are distinct and not additive.

pack_analysis.interpretation: For deltified rows, verify-pack entry_size_bytes is the delta instruction-stream size; uncompressed_size_bytes is the expanded object size obtained from git cat-file. packed_data_bytes is the physical compressed representation. Pack, index, reverse-index, and tree-entry overhead are separate.

historical_storage_analysis.current_tip_definition: HEAD commit plus all trees/blobs in the current HEAD tree; historical-only is the reachable object set outside that tip set.
historical_storage_analysis.generated_history_method: git log --all --full-history --raw --abbrev=40 --no-renames -- data/generated; old/new blob IDs collected for current generated paths.
historical_storage_analysis.interpretation: Historical values are uncompressed reachable object-content estimates. Ordinary future deletion keeps old blobs reachable through parent commits.

cold_archive_re_evaluation.historical_reachability_rule: A future deleting commit has the current HEAD as an ancestor, so current blobs remain reachable without history rewriting.

STRATEGY_A_DO_NOTHING.assessment: Git native content addressing already shares exact duplicate blobs.

STRATEGY_B_DESCRIPTOR_CONTENT_ADDRESSED_.assessment: Not justified solely by duplicate paths; the duplicate blob content is already shared.

STRATEGY_C_COLD_ARCHIVE_UNIQUE_PAYLOADS.assessment: Recommended C3 boundary only after descriptor-first verification; history objects remain.

history_rewrite_assessment.recommendation: The historical-only reachable blob set is large enough to evaluate a separate destructive migration, but C2.1 performs none.
risks: provenance references to old commits may break

git_history_distinction.HEAD: current tree occurrences and unique blob content
git_history_distinction.object_database: compressed packs, loose objects, indexes, and reverse indexes
git_history_distinction.history: prior versions remain reachable after ordinary deletion
git_history_distinction.history_rewrite: filter-repo/orphan-history/force-push is a separate destructive milestone

protected_expectations.statement: No existing protected artifact was changed by C2.1.

limitations: Physical post-migration pack savings cannot be known without a future commit/pack.
verify-pack packed data excludes tree-entry attribution and index overhead.
C2 archive labels remain proposals; C2.1 migrates nothing.
No repack, prune, or history rewrite was attempted.
